_comment: dev-ai-standards Claude Code settings snippet (core, Model use and Enforcement). Defaults and reminders, not security controls.
Keys starting with '_' are notes for people; apply and anyone copying this file leave them out (whether Claude Code accepts unknown keys is unproven until A4).
Version floor: Claude Code 2.1.251 or later. Before it, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL overrode the per-call model parameter and frontmatter (code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents, 2026-11-10).
Model map: the main session runs the strongest model (the operator's choice, not set here); routine subagents run sonnet, which never reviews.
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL does not reach the built-in Explore and Plan agents: pass model on each of those calls. Never set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE.
attribution.commit is the one standard trailer; sessionUrl false keeps the Claude-Session trailer out of cloud and Remote Control commits.

permissions.ask: prompts even in auto mode; not a boundary, and Codex ignores it. Bare forms are listed because a rule with two wildcards doesn't match a command with no trailing arguments. Each pattern is tested at A4.
Project .claude/settings.json gets env, attribution and permissions (written by apply). User settings (wave 4) get env and attribution only, without permissions.ask. No autoMode, no secrets here.
